credibility.line: Only one promise can be checked against reported numbers so far — too few to score.

narrative_vs_numbers.point: Management highlights FY26 revenue growth to ₹1,75,431 cr, but operating cash flow stayed deeply negative at -₹17,810 cr.
Management targets net debt/EBITDA under 2, but total borrowings expanded to ₹2,27,853 cr pushing D/E ratio to 2.2.
Consolidated Q1 FY27 revenue reached ₹48,716 cr (up 21.4% YoY), validating management's strong top-line narrative.

bull: Q1 FY27 revenue grew 21.4% YoY to ₹48,716 cr with EBITDA margin expanding to 23.0%.
Birla Opus Q1 FY27 paint revenue grew 64% YoY to ₹1,661 cr, surpassing the 50% growth target.
FY26 consolidated revenue reached ₹1,75,431 cr, up 18.2% from ₹1,48,478 cr in FY25.
bear: 5-year cumulative cash conversion is negative (-102%), with FY26 OCF at -₹17,810 cr.
Total borrowings escalated to ₹2,27,853 cr in Mar 2026, driving D/E ratio up to 2.2.
Free cash flow was heavily negative at -₹33,130 cr in FY26 due to continuous expansion capex.
watch: Birla Pivot EBITDA breakeven exit by Q4 FY27.
Consolidated net debt to EBITDA trajectory staying below 2.0.
FY27 standalone capex spend against ₹3,157 cr guidance.
